terms.comment: Classically a footman or page (Plaut.; Cic. Att. 2.16.1), which is what the knave is: the Latin, like the French valet, names the picture. Morgan–Owens has the entry but no Latin for it.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency: p. 51, checked against the searchable text of the book on 11 November 2026.
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. card ranks: jack, knave.
